name: in-notice-period-fnf-settlement
description: Work through an Indian employee's exit money: the notice period from the appointment letter and standing orders, notice pay and buy-out, what a full and final settlement must contain (last salary, leave encashment, bonus, gratuity, reimbursements, deductions and recoveries), the usual timelines, a reconciliation checklist and a polite escalation email if the settlement is late. Use when asked how much notice do I have to serve, can I buy out my notice period, F&F kab milega aur kya kya milega, my full and final is late, or to check an F&F statement. Produces the notice position, an itemised F&F estimate, and the escalation email.
